content.short: Grindery is a Smart Wallet on Telegram that simplifies payments using AI and usernames for a seamless Web3 experience.
content.description: Grindery is an innovative 'Smart Wallet' integrated directly into Telegram, designed to make Web3 as simple as traditional messaging. It utilizes account abstraction and AI-native features to allow users to send and receive payments using simple usernames instead of complex wallet addresses. Supporting both TON and EVM chains, Grindery focuses on lowering the barrier to entry for crypto payments and automation, providing a highly accessible gateway for the next billion users to enter the decentralized economy.
content.meta: Simplify crypto payments with Grindery Smart Wallet on Telegram. AI-powered Web3 on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
